MARS Oncology Veterinarians
Vet cancer care is guided by a collaborative team of specialists at Melbourne Animal Referral Services.
Our oncology veterinarians work closely with pet owners, referring veterinarians and related MARS specialists to provide clear guidance, coordinated treatment planning and compassionate care throughout your pet’s cancer journey.
Meet Our Oncology Veterinarians
The MARS oncology veterinarians provide specialist cancer care for dogs and cats, helping guide diagnosis, treatment planning and ongoing care.
They work closely with referring veterinarians, pet owners, and the wider MARS team to ensure each pet’s care is carefully considered, with recommendations shaped by their diagnosis, treatment goals, comfort, and quality of life.
Dr. Paul Crocker
Dr. Paul brings extensive knowledge and experience to the role, having worked in both primary care and specialist referral settings, managing complex medical cases and supporting multidisciplinary teams. He’s also worked in clinical education and professional development, including teaching medicine at the University of Adelaide.
He’ll be leading our oncology team and working alongside our Internal Medicine and Surgical Specialists to provide a broad scope of oncology support and treatments, helping ensure your pet receives the highest standard of care.

Providing advanced surgery & surgical procedures to achieve the best health outcomes for your pet.

Oncology Telehealth
Our team offers advanced diagnostic & treatment for pets facing complex health issues.
Collaborative Cancer Care at MARS
Cancer care often involves more than one specialist area. At MARS, our oncology veterinarians work alongside
Internal Medicine
and
Surgical
specialists to provide a connected approach to cancer diagnosis, treatment planning and ongoing care. They also receive external support from a large specialist oncology network to ensure your pet receives the best possible, most comprehensive care.
This collaborative model allows each pet’s condition to be reviewed from the most appropriate clinical perspectives, helping pet owners and referring veterinarians understand the available options and next steps.
Working With Internal Medicine & Surgical Specialists
Depending on your pet’s diagnosis, cancer care at MARS may involve input from
oncology
,
internal medicine
,
surgery
,
diagnostic imaging
, or other veterinary specialists.
Our Internal Medicine specialists may assist with complex medical conditions, diagnostic investigation and broader health considerations that can influence a pet’s cancer care plan.
Our Surgical specialists may be involved where tumour removal, biopsy, surgical staging or other specialist procedures are recommended as part of treatment.
Together, these teams help provide coordinated care for pets diagnosed with cancer, with a focus on clear communication, practical next steps and the highest standard of patient care.
To learn more about the specialists involved in patient care at MARS, visit our
Meet the Team page
.
Specialist Oncology Support & Treatments
Cancer care can involve several stages, from initial investigation and diagnosis through to treatment planning, procedures, follow-up care and ongoing monitoring.
Our oncology veterinarians may assist with:
Reviewing referral history and diagnostic findings
Recommending next steps for cancer investigation or staging
Discussing available treatment pathways
Coordinating care with related MARS specialist teams and external specialist teams
Guiding oncology treatment planning
Helping assess comfort, quality of life and long-term care needs
Providing referring veterinarians with specialist oncology input
As an animal referral hospital in Melbourne, MARS provides specialist veterinary services for pets who need advanced cancer care, coordinated case planning or input from multiple specialist teams.
For more information about available
vet cancer care
services, visit our
Oncology Services
.
Where appropriate, patients may also be supported through
oncology telehealth consults
, providing referring veterinarians with access to specialist advice when planning care.
Need specialist cancer care for your patient?
Our Melbourne-based oncology veterinarians work with Internal Medicine, Surgical and related MARS specialists to provide coordinated cancer care for dogs and cats.
Collaborative cancer care supports clearer decisions because every detail matters.

Cancer Care for Dogs & Cats
MARS provides coordinated oncology care for dogs and cats, with recommendations guided by each pet’s diagnosis, treatment goals and quality of life.
Our oncology veterinarians work closely with MARS Internal Medicine and Surgical specialists to provide a broad scope of cancer care, from diagnosis and treatment planning through to ongoing management.
Depending on each pet’s needs, care may include advanced diagnostics, medical oncology, surgery and other specialist services, with the wider MARS referral team working together throughout their treatment journey.
Explore our services to learn more about cancer care, treatment options, and available procedures.

Additional External Specialist Input
Where required, MARS may also work with external veterinary specialists to provide additional oncology expertise or procedures as part of a pet’s broader cancer care plan.
This gives patients access to further specialist input when needed, while keeping their care coordinated through the MARS veterinary referral hospital team.
Frequently Asked Questions
Who is part of the MARS oncology team?
The MARS oncology team includes oncology veterinarians, Internal Medicine specialists, Surgical specialists and related referral hospital teams who work together to care for pets diagnosed with cancer.
What do oncology veterinarians do?
Oncology veterinarians help diagnose, assess and treat cancer in pets. They may guide treatment planning, recommend further investigations, discuss available treatment options and work with other specialists to coordinate ongoing care.
Will my pet’s care involve other MARS specialists?
Depending on your pet’s diagnosis, care may involve other MARS teams, including diagnostic imaging, internal medicine or surgery. This helps ensure your pet’s treatment plan is considered from the most appropriate clinical perspectives.
Where can I learn more about MARS oncology services?
You can learn more about available cancer care services on the
MARS Oncology Services
page.
Can my vet refer my pet to the oncology team?
Yes. Referring veterinarians can submit a
referral online
. Once the referral has been reviewed, the MARS team can help guide the next appropriate step for your pet.
HAVE A QUESTION FOR OUR ONCOLOGY VETS?
Speak with the MARS team to discuss the next step in your pet’s cancer care.
